title: Cyrus and the Well
author: Silas Thackeray
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
